title: Rune fusion
changes: Morwen in Oakvale and Zahra in Kel Ashar now fuse runes: bring 4 identical loose runes and get one rune of the next rank.
Fusing costs 100 gold for a Lesser rune and 400 gold for a plain one. Greater runes are the top rank.
Zahra now buys loose runes too.
Runes set in your gear never count: take them out first.
